tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// nor bu bstan pa'i spyi dbang bskur tshul rje yab sras kyi phyag len bklag chog ma bzhugs so//

/bla ma dang mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir nor bu bstan pa'i spyi dbang du grags pa 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po me skyes kyis dpal ldan gro mo che bdud rtsi grags la dngos su gnang ba chos spyod bcu'i nyams len la dbang ba 'di lag tu blang ba la gsum/ sta gon/ dngos bzhi/ rjes so// dang po sta gon ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su dkon mchog gi rten bkram/ mchod pa dang spyan gzigs sna tshogs pas brjid chags par ji ltar 'tsham pa'i stegs bu'i steng du rdul tshon nam/ gtso bo la dri bzang gis sbags pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar/ stegs kyi steng du bdag cag gi ston pa'i sku cha tshad rab gnas dang ldan pa bshams/ de'i mdun du bka' 'am bstan bcos tshad ldan gyi glegs bam bkod pa'i mthar/ kha na ma mtho ba med pa'i mchod rdzas ji snyed bkod legs par bshams/ dung zhal du dri bzang gi chu dang*/ rdo rje dril bu me tog rnams slob dpon gyi nye logs su bshams/ rab tu byung ba yin na snam sbyar dang bcas pas seng ge'i khri la sogs par 'khod la/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gyad dang seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i steng du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam gyi stobs las byung ba'i rin po che'i pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa/ kha dog dri bsung reg bya tshad med pa'i lte bar/ 'od kyi phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du/ muṃ yig 'dzam bu nā da'i khams ltar 'bar ba'i 'od kyis sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bkod tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

ngur smrig gi chos gos gsum mnabs shing*/ dbu'i gtsug tor bltar mi mngon pa sogs mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ phyag zhabs kyi sen mo zangs mdog lta bu sogs dpe byad brgyad cus spras pa/ 'khor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba sprin gyi phung po dkrigs pa ltar gsal ba'i/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs nas gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ sogs nas/ dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// bar brjod/ mchod pa rnams spyi 'gro ltar byin brlabs/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa kun// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma'am bdun ma gang rigs 'bul/ phyog bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing*// mchod sprin rgya mtshos rab tu mchod// sdig pa thams cad sor sor bshags// dus gsum dge la rjes yi rang*// chos 'khor rgya chen bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /ces dang*/ mdo'i yan lag bdun pa'ang bya/ bstod pa ni/ sems can rnams la brtse ba can// phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can// mi 'bral ba yi dgongs pa can// phan bde dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni ye swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ bdag 'jug blangs/ de nas slob ma rnams kyis slob dpon la sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i nor rdzas 'bul zhing phyag 'tshal/ mdun du pus btsug thal sbyar gyis 'khod par dung zhal gyi chus khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad pa ni/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ a kā ro gsum dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags gsum gyis bsngos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams chos spyod bcu la 'jug rung du bya ba nor bu bstan pa'i spyi dbang zab mo bgyi ba la/ bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad la sbyin no// tshim zhing rang bar bgyis la gnas 'dir ma 'dug par gzhan du dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas bsreg cing brlag par gdon mi za'o// rol chen dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ badz+ra rak+ṣa'i srung 'khor bsgoms/ me tog byin nas maṇ+ḍal phul tshar rjes/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du chos spyod bcu la 'jug rung du bya ba nor bu bstan pa'i spyi dbang zab mo gsan nas thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa'i thugs bskyed lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang bcas te gsan dgos pa'i tshul ni/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces gsungs pa ltar gsal btab nas/ gang gsan par bya ba ni/ de yang mdo bskal bzang las/ nga ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa'i tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub chen la// 'jam gang zhig ni dbul ba byas nas kyang*// dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// zhes gsungs pas rang cag gi ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po 'di nyid grong khyer yangs pa'i 'od du rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed ces bya bar gyur pa'i tshe/

de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa chen po la til mar gyi snum dang*/ chu dro ba'i 'jam dang bcas te phul nas dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog du sangs rgyas zin kyang*/ lang gshegs las/ gtsang ma'i gnas ni spangs pa yi// 'og min gnas mchog nyams dga' bar// yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas// sprul pa po zhig 'dir 'tshang rgya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshe/ dus/ sems can/ nyon mongs/ lta ba snyigs ma ste snyigs ma rnam pa lnga lhag par bdo ba'i skabs 'dir/ sngon gyi thugs bskyed kyi mthus 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir snang tshul du mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan pa ste/ de yang gang zhe na/ rgyud bla ma las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen// 'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni// chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par// sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis// skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*// dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang*// lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang*// bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang*// btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol ba dang*// nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang*// byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*// bdud sde bcom dang rdzogs pa ni// byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang*// mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams// yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su// srid pa ji srid gnas pa ston// zhes pa ltar/ dga' ldan gyi gnas su byang sems dam pa tog dkar por sku skye ba bzhes te lha'i gdul bya rnams la chos bstan cing*/ gzigs pa rnam pa lngar gzigs nas 'dod pa'i ris kyi lha drug la/ khyod gang gi bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba de dag /mi yul dbus kyi grong khyer drug po gang rung du skye bas mtshams sbyor zhig ces lan gsum gyi bar du gdams nas/ bar srid glang po che thal dkar mche ba drug par bsgyur nas yab yum lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo gso sbyong la gnas pa'i lhums su zhugs nas/

zla ba bcu rdzogs pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' ring nas dben pa la goms pa'i dbang gis yum la tshal du 'byon 'dod kyi snang ba shar ba'i tshe/ yab zas gtsang chen pos/ shākya legs pa rab sad la khyod kyi bu mo tshal la dga' ba'i snang ba shar gyis bya ba gang yin pa sgrubs shig /ces bskul bas grong khyer lhas bstan dang ser skya'i bar du lum+bi ni zhes bya ba'i tshal bskyed do// der lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo tshal nas tshal du bskyod cing mchis pa'i tshe yum de nyid khrel dang ngo tsha la goms pa'i stabs kyis lha dbang gi mthus char drag po bab ste 'khor rnams phyogs bcur byer ba dang*/ shing ardzu na'i yal ga 'dud pa bzhin du gyur pa'i dus su/ yum gyis shing gi yal gar 'jus te bya rmyang mdzad pa'i sku'i rtsib logs g.yas pa nas/ nyi ma sprin gseb nas thon pa bzhin sku bltams pa'i mod la/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis dar dkar gyi sle'us len par rtsam pas ma theg par 'dar bar gyur pa'i skabs/ byang chub sems dpa'i zhal nas kau shi ka bdag thong zhig /ces gsungs pas/ btang ba na shar lho nub byang rnams su gom pa bdun bor te ched brjod mdzad/ de'i tshe'i mtha' bzhi'i rgyal po bzhi la bu bzhi btsas/ ser skya'i grong du yang grags 'dzin ma sogs bu mo lnga brgya dang*/ glang po che dang rta lnga brgya la phru gu lnga brgya re btsas/ gter lnga brgya yang rdol te/ khab tu byon nas bram ze mtshan mkhan gyis mtshan brtags pas/ khab tu bzhugs na 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ rab tu byung na sangs rgyas su 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ de nas rim gyis bskyed bsrings te gzhon nu'i rol rtsed la zhugs pas sgyu rtsal gyi bya ba mthar son/ shakya'i bu mo sa mtsho ma rgyal ba'i ru mtshon du bzhag ste sgyu rtsal 'gran pas/ lhas byin sogs sgyu rtsal gyi mngon pa'i nga rgyal can thams cad pham par mdzad de/ shākya lag na be con gyi sras mo sa 'tsho ma drug khri khab tu bzhes te/

dgung lo nyer dgu bzhes pa'i dus su grong khyer gyi sgo bzhir bskyod pas/ rga ba dang*/ na ba dang*/ 'chi ba dang*/ dge slong bcas gzigs pa'i rkyen gyis skye 'chi med pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba'i tshe/ lha rnams kyis kyang bskul nas khab nas byung ste gyad yul du gshegs nas mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du nyid la nyid rab tu byung*/ de nas drang srong ngan spong gi bu'i bsti gnas sogs las brgyud cing ring 'phur dang lhag spyod sogs kyi gan du bzhud de/ de'i dka' thub las nyis 'gyur dang*/ snyoms par 'jug pa dag skad cig gis mngon du mdzad cing*/ de dag la snying po med par gzigs te/ mu stegs dka' thub la zhen pa dag 'dul ba'i ched dang*/ 'dod pa bsod snyoms gyi mtha' spang ba'i ched du chu bo ne rañja na'i 'gram du lo drug tu dka' ba spyad/ rang nyid dub pa'i mtha' spang ba'i ched du grong khyer bde can du gshegs nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo dga' mo dang dga' stobs mas drangs pa'i 'o thug nying khur sbyar ba gsol bas sku'i stobs bskyed pa'i tshul mdzad cing*/ ma ga dhar byon nas byang chub kyi shing gi drung du sku sha'i stan la skyil mo krung gis bzhugs te/ gnas 'dir bdag gi lus 'di skam yang rung*/ /pags pa rus pa'i tshogs rnams zhig kyang rung*// bskal mang rnyed dka'i byang chub ma thob bar// stan 'di las ni 'gul bar mi bya'o// zhes pa'i dam bca' mdzad de bsam gtan la snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe/ srod la 'dod khams kyi bdag po bdud sdig to can sde dpung dang bcas pas cho 'phrul rnam pa du ma dang bcas te bar chad brtsams kyang*/ byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bdud bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug btul/ gung la mngon par shes pa lnga bskyed/ tho rangs la rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis shes bya'i sgrib pa bcom nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon du byas te/

bdun phrag bdun gyi bar du btang snyoms su bzhugs pas/ tshangs pa chen pos chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab pas gnang ste/ wā rā ṇa sīr dge slong lnga sder 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor lan gsum du bzlas te bskor nas srid pa'i rtsa ba bcad/ gzhan yang nye ba'i lnga sde sogs gdul bya mang po dang*/ steng rgyas su steng rgyas 'od srung sogs dang*/ ma ga dha nas chos rgyal gzugs can snying po sogs brgya stong du ma'i don mdzad/ mgon med zas sbyin gyis zhus te ko sa lar byon/ gnyan yod du rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal brtsigs shing der bzhugs pa'i tshe yab kyis gsol ba btab nas ser skyar phebs pa sogs mdzad pa'i rjes su/ dze ta'i tshal du ston pa drug sogs mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis brgyags pa dag cho 'phrul chen po bstan nas tshar bcad/ grong khyer gsal bar lha las bab par bstan/ yangs pa can du sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs/ rim gyis ma la yar gshegs te shing sā la zung gi tshal du dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su rgyal po ma skyes dgras sbyin bdag mdzad nas n+ya gro dha'i phug par nyan thos chen po 'od srung sogs dgra bcom lnga brgya 'dus te bka' bsdu dang*/ 'od srung chen po nas kun dga' bo la bstan pa gtad pa sogs gtad rabs bdun sogs kyis 'phags yul du bstan pa dar bar mdzad cing*/ gangs can 'dir yang slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ bod chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum sogs kyi sku drin la brten nas bstan pa'i sgron me gsal bar mdzad pa'i don rnams ni chos spyod bcu'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid kyi// mdo don dran pa la bzhag nas// blo dang ldan pas mthong 'gyur phyir// bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes// bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin// zhes so//

bcu po de dag gang zhe na/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*// nyan dang klog dang len pa dang*// 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*| |de sems pa dang bsgom pa ste// zhes rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa yi ger 'bri ba/ mchod pa/ sbyin pa/ nyan pa/ klog pa/ 'chad pa/ kha ton byed pa/ gzhan nas len pa/ don sems pa/ don sgom pa rnams yin la/ de yang theg pa che chung gnyis las/ theg chen lugs kyi chos spyod bcu la brtson pa ni mchog yin te/ dbus mtha' las/ spyod pa de bcu'i bdag nyid ni// bsod nams phung po dpag tu med// khyad par phyir dang mi zad phyir// gzhan la phan 'dogs ma zhi'i phyir// zhes gsungs pas/ theg dman las theg chen gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i khyad par du gyur pa'i phyir dang*/ skye ba gcig gis bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du lus dang bral ma thag tu zhi bar mi 'gyur ba'i phyir lhag par bsod nams che ba tsam du ma zad sangs rgyas dang chos la yang dbye ba med de/ rgyud bla mar/ gang phyir de ni chos sku de bzhin gshegs// de ni 'phags pa'i bden pa don dam mya ngan 'das// de phyir nyi dang zer bzhin yon tan dbyer med pa'i// sangs rgyas nyid las ma gtogs mya ngan 'das pa med// ces so// de ltar chos spyod bcu la 'jug rung du bya ba'i dbang bskur zab mo 'di nyid 'phags pa dgra bcom pa me skyes kyis/ bka' gdams bstan pa'i gzhung 'dzin snar thang mkhan po dpal ldan gro mo che bdud rtsi grags la dngos su gnang ba yin la/ dam pa de nyid kyis zhang ston chos kyi bla ma la stsal/ de nas rim bzhin sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ 'chim nam mkha' grags/ zho ra ba 'khor lo seng ge/ la du ba bsod nams seng ge/ mus pa dpal ldan seng ge/ snyag dbon bsod nams bzang po/ ban sgar ba 'jam dpal bzang po/ karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho/ ngo bro dbang phyug dpal/ 'bri gung ma ṇi ba kun dga' rnam rgyal/

si tu chos kyi go cha/ bla ma karma bzang po/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sbyin pa phun tshogs/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pa/ bla ma dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje phrin las bzang po/ don grub chos kyi rgyal po/ mgar chen bstan 'dzin nyi ma/ rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan/ khri chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rang byung chos nyid nor bu/ dkon mchog thugs rje nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi blo gros/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dkon mchog bstan 'dzin shan+ta ma tis chos grags man bla brgyud kha bskang ba'o// mchan/ bdag la dgyes bzhin du stsal ba ste brgyud pa rnam par dag pa nas brgyud cing*/ byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma nyams pa 'di nyid kyi dngos gzhi dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khyod zhabs pad+mo spang nas ni// gtso bo gzhan la skyabs mi mchi// 'gro ba'i mgon po thub chen gyis// blo mchog ting 'dzin brnyes par mdzod// brtse ldan khyod kyi mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas// bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs rtogs pa yi// blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba stsal du gsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ khyed rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i pad+ma'i sdong po yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i khri'i steng du pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la/ bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po bzhugs pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba mngon gsum sprin gyi phung po dkrigs pa ltar gsal btab pa'i mdun du yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing*// mchod sprin rgya mtshos rab tu mchod// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// dus gsum dge la rjes yi rang*// chos 'khor rgya chen bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog

/ces lan gsum bya/ de nas/ ston pa'i sku gzugs ni bem po'i snang ba med par ston pa dngos su bsam pas der 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ gang zhig sangs rgyas yid byed pa// de yi mdun na thub pa bzhugs// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de dag gi mdun du lus ri rab kyi rdul snyed dang mnyam par sprul zhing*/ lus re re la lce yang de snyed gyur pas ston pa la phyag mchod bstod pa byas par mos la/ ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs kyis bstod/ slar yang dbang gi byed po slob dpon yin pas/ de yang tha mal pa'i rnam par mi blta bar/ skad cig gis gyad dang seng ge brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i steng du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam gyi stobs las byung ba'i rin po che'i pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa kha dog dri bsung reg bya tshad med pa'i lte bar/ 'od kyi phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du/ muṃ yig dzam+bu nā da'i khams ltar 'bar ba'i 'od kyis sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bkod tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ phyag g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam bzhag zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa ngur smrig gi chos gos gsum mnabs shing dbu'i gtsug tor bltar mi mngon pa sogs mtshan bzang po sum cu so gnyis dang*| phyag zhabs kyi sen mo zangs mdog lta bu sogs dpe byad brgyad cus spras pa/ de'i thugs kar chos kyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar muṃ yig gser lta bu'i mtha' skor du oṃ mu ni mu ni mahā mu ni ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng gser btso ma lta bus g.yas su bskor bar gsal btab la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*| |nyan dang klog dang len pa dang*// 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*// de sems pa dang bsgom pa yi// dbang bskur dam pa bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar bsgoms pa'i 'khor lo sa bon sngags dang bcas pa de kho na 'dra ba mdun bskyed kyi thub pa'i dbang po'i thugs kar yang gsal btab/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags dang bcas pa gnyis ka las gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa drang nges kyi chos thams cad yig 'bru dang ā di kā di'i rnam pa gser btso ma lta bu mtha' yas pa spros pa zhal nas thon slob ma'i rna bar brgyud de lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang lung rtogs kyi chos nyams su len zhing de dag gi yon tan brgyud la bskyed pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs chen po bzhi dang*/ mi shes pa'i rgyu bzhi/ ma rig pa gnyis/ rmongs pa'i dri ma thams cad sangs kyis sbyangs/ sgo gsum rnam par dag te rgyal ba'i chos thams cad la dbang chub par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces spos rol mo dang bcas dpon slob gnyis kas mos par bya/ thub sku mgor bzhag la/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*// nyan dang klog dang len pa dang*// 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*// de sems pa dang bsgom pa yi// dbang bskur dam pa khyod la sbyin// zhes dang mu ni brjod/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang me tog 'thor/ des slob ma'i lus thub pa'i dbang po'i sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ ngag drang nges kyi chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi ngo bo/ sems mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes can shes bya thams cad la chags thogs med pa'i blo gros phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i 'khor lo sa bon sngags dang bcas pa las de 'dra ba re re chad de zhal nas thon slob ma'i khar zhugs ma thag

/slob ma thub pa'i dbang por gsal ba'i thugs kar 'khor lo sa bon sngags bcas gsal ba la thim pas 'khor lo dang sa bon mi 'gul bar/ sngags phreng g.yas su 'od sgor sgor 'khor ba'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni ye swā hā/ zhes mu ni rjes zlos brgya rtsa brgyad bya/ slar dpon slob thams cad kyi mu ni bzla bzhin par/ glegs bam slob ma'i mgor bzhag cing*/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*// nyan dang klog dang len pa dang*// 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*// de sems pa dang bsgom pa yi// lung mchog dam pa thob gyur cig /ces slob dpon gyis brjod cing dbang bskur/ mthar slob mas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang me tog 'thor/ mthar/ slob dpon thub pa'i dbang por gsal ba dang mdun bskyed kyi thub pa'i dbang po gnyis 'od zer nyi ma lta bur gyur pa gnyis gcig tu 'dres pa slob ma la sib kyis thim pas slob ma yang 'od kyi rang bzhin du sang kyis song*/ de'i ngang nas tshogs drug gi snang cha rnams med bzhin du kun rdzob bden par snang ba'i ngo bor bltas te rig pa bcos min rang thog tu bzhag pas gang gis kyang 'dzin pa med pa de ni don dam bden pa ye gdod ma nas rang la gnas pa'i chos nyid yin te/ jo bo rjes/ kun rdzob ji ltar snang ba 'di// rig pas brtag na 'ga' mi snang*// ma rnyed pa de don dam yin// ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid do// zhes gsungs la/ de ltar rig pa gsal stong 'dzin med de ni blo las 'das pa'i chos sku yin te/ de la dri ma phar la bsal bya dang yon tan tshur la bzhag rgyu med pa sems gsal stong yang dag pa de nyid la rnam rtog gi mtshan mas ma bslad par yang dag par bltas pas sems nyid gdod nas chos skur grub zin yang dag de mthong zhing*/

de mthong bas ni 'khor 'das kyi re dogs gnyis 'dzin las grol te chos skur 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir/ mgon po byams pas/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba'ang cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes gsungs pas de'i don la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// de lta bu'i gnas lugs kyi don ji lta ba ni bla ma'i man ngag zab mo thos pa ji lta ba bsgoms pa las rtogs kyi gzhan gang gis kyang mi rtogs te/ mgon po byams pas/ phra phyir thos pa'i yul min la// don dam phyir na bsam pas min// chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten pa'i// bsgom pa dag gis rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma'i man ngag med na gang yang don thog tu mi 'bab ste/ rje mai tri pas/ bla ma'i ngag gis ma brgyan pa'i// dbu ma'ang 'bring po tsam du zad| |ces gsungs so/ /'di ni chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong grangs mang yang don 'bras 'di las gzhan gang yang bstan pa med de/ ji skad du/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa gang yin pa// chos nyid 'di la gzhol cing 'bab// ces sogs gsungs la/ don dam nam mkha' lta bu de'i ngang la blta ba'i shes rab kyi mig gis kun rdzob chos spyod bcu la sogs pa tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa la 'bad pa ni/ don dam rtogs byed kyi thabs khyad par can yin te/ ji skad du/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba ma rdzogs par| |de srid stong nyid dam pa thob mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs la/ don dam spros bral gyi ngang nas kun rdzob gzugs sku gnyis sogs spros pa du mas/ gzhan don sgrub pa ni rang mdangs rang rtsal 'gag med du shar ba yin pas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i blos sems can gyi don tshad med pa bsgrub pa la 'bad dgos so// des chos spyod bcu rang nyid kyis sgrub pa dang gzhan bsgrub tu 'jug pa sogs la dbang 'byor/

rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag la thos bsam sgom pa byed pa la dbang bar byas pa yin pas dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung bar gal che bas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ */ces dang*/ de ltar grub pa'i gtang rag tu lus longs spyod thams cad bla ma la phul nas drug cha gcig chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen du slar zhu dgos snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba yi// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes brjod/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo// de ltar dbang thob nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa chos spyod bcu'i sgo nas 'dzin skyong la 'bad dgos la/ de yang chos las gzhan pa 'jig rten gyi rnam bzhag byed kyang thog mar yi ge mi shes par byed pa ni blun po ste/ slob dpon a nus/ bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing*// rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu// ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi// yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya// zhes gsungs pa ste/ dper na chos spyod bcu nyams su blang tshul mchim nam mkha' grags kyi phyag len ltar bgyi ste/ ༈ /dang po yi ge 'bri ba'i tshe gnas yid dang mthun par me tog gi re kha nyis rim tshom bu dgu bkod pa'i steng du khri'i khar phyi mo bzhag mchod pa bshams/ rang stan la bde bar 'khod/ skyabs sems sngon du btang*/ mchod pa phul gsol ba btab/ phyi mo zhal phye bas yig 'bru rnams 'od kyi rnam par byon bdag gi spyi bor thim pas sdig sgrib dag par bsam pa lan gsum bya/ dngos gzhi 'bri ba'i tshe phyi mo chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin las bris pa de sprul pa'i skur byon par bsam/ mthar dge ba bsngo| ༈ /gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su stegs kyi khar glegs bam bzhag /mchod bstod sogs sbyor rjes gong dang 'dra/

dngos gzhi yig 'bru las 'od byung bdag la thim pas sdig sgrib dag par bsam pa 'di ni chos spyod bcu ga la sbyor dgos pas thun mong gi chos su gsungs/ ༈ /gsum pa glegs bam sbyin pa ni/ yul dang chos la gdan bshams/ dbul yul dang dbul ba po gnyis kas skyabs sems bya/ gnyis kas chos sbyin pa la gzhan don gyi sems bskyed dang*/ chos la dad pa dang*/ yid dang ba gsum med na mi rung bas de ltar chos gsum ldan yul gnyis kas gsal btab/ dbul ba pos glegs bam lag tu thogs nas/ 'di la chos spyod bcu rdzogs par mdzod la rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu| zhes sbyin/ len pa pos gus pa'i tshul gyis de kho na ltar bgyid do// zhes blangs/ sbyor rjes sngar ltar ro// ༈ /bzhi pa nyan pa ni/ sbyor rjes 'dra/ dngos gzhi 'chad pa po la ston pa'i zhal gyi sgo dang phyag gi glegs bam gyi yig 'bru las 'od byung*/ 'khor bzhi/ lha srin sde brgyad sogs thams cad la phog pas nyan par bskul zhing*/ tshe thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad 'byang bar lan gsum tsam gsal btab la ma yeng bar nyan no// ༈ /lnga pa klog pa ni/ sbyor rjes gong mtshungs/ klog pa'i sngon du/ ston pa'i slob ma sems can gang su dag /'jig rten khams na gnas pa kun nyon cig /deng 'dir ston pa'i gsung rab char 'bebs kyi// gang su nyan par 'dod rnams 'dir spyon cig |ces brjod/ mdo'i brjod bya rjod byed la brten pa dang*/ gzhan la ston pa dang*/ bstan pa klad la bkur ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems te 'du shes bzhi gsal btab la/ myur bul chad lhag la sogs pa'i skyon spangs te tshig gi don bsam zhing klog /thun mtshams sogs su tshig mtshams bzang por bzhag ༈ /drug pa len pa ni/ sbyor rjes sngar bzhin| dngos gzhi dpe las tshig don len pa yin te/ ji tsam nus pa rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i blos phar phyin drug ldan du len te/

tshig don len cing mchod bstod 'bul ba sbyin pa/ de'i tshe bag dang ldan par byed pa tshul khrims/ nyon mongs kyi rtog pa las log pa bzod pa/ le lo mi bya ba brtson 'grus/ don sems pa bsam gtan/ don la dpyod pa shes rab yin no// ༈ /bdun pa 'chad pa ni/ sbyor rjes sngar dang mtshungs/ rang gi lce las 'od 'phros nyan po thams cad la phog pas chos spang ba sogs chos rtogs pa'i gegs dang sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ chos kyi sbyin pas lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu thams cad tshim par bgyis par bsam la/ rang nyid ston pa'i nga rgyal la gnas pa'i lung rigs tshig don thams cad ston pa'i gsung dang mi 'gal zhing*/ rang 'dod rnyed brtson khengs dregs khyad gsod rtsod sems sogs dang bral bar lhag pa'i bsam pas 'chad do// ༈ /brgyad pa kha ton byed pa ni/ klog bzhin pa las yig 'bru las 'od 'phros pa mi dgos gsungs/ ༈ /dgu pa de sems pa ni/ dpe las sems na sbyor rjes yi ge 'bri ba'i dus ltar la/ dngos gzhi ji tsam nus par dpe klog cing de'i don legs par bsam par bya/ dpe med na gzhan gyis bshad pa'i don sems pa'am/ rang gi blor rgyal ba'i gsung rab gang yod kyi don tshul bzhin du sems par bya'o// ༈ /bcu pa bsgom pa ni/ de thams cad kyi gtso bo yin la de yang sbyor ba sngar dang mtshungs/ dngos gzhi thun mong dang*/ thun min gnyis/ thun mong ni/ dbu ma chen po ltar rang gzhan gyi stong pa dang*/ sher phyin ltar stong nyid bco brgyad sogs lung rigs kyis rjes su dpags shing de bsgom pa ni yid byed dang ma bral zhing spros pa can thun mong ba'i sgom pa yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsgom pa ni/ sngar dbang gi skabs bshad pa ltar dang*/ gzhan yang dam pa gong ma rnams kyis/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i don// zhes sogs mang du gsungs pas/ des na gnas lugs rtogs pa'am/ bla ma dam pas ngo sprad pa ltar tshul bzhin du bsgoms pas sangs rgyas lag bcang 'bras bu phyi dus la re mi dgos pa zhig 'byung ba ni/

sgrub brgyud dam pa rnams kyi bka' srol dang phyag bzhes ma nyams pa kho na las 'byung gi/ gzhan pa'i stong nyid spros bral don dam bden pa rtogs su re bas thal phyir spros bcas kun rdzob bden pa kha bshad mkhan rnams kyis chos sku rtogs su re ba ni chu las mar 'byung ba dang mtshungs par nges so// de ltar chos spyod bcu ga'ang sems can phyogs ris med pa'i don kho nas bsam pa la 'grub kyi/ de las gzhan pa'i rang don rnyed brtson khe grags lo 'dod chos brgyad kyi bsam pa zhugs na kha zas bzang po dug gis sbags pa dang 'dra bas/ de lta bu'i lhad ma zhugs par bya/ gsum pa rjes ni/ de dag thams cad kyi mthar bsngo bas rgyas btab cing dmigs med sgyu ma lta bur blo nges par bya'o// gong gi gtang rag maṇ+ḍal 'dir sbyor dgos pa 'dra lags/ tshul 'di ni ta'i si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan dge legs dpal bzang pos gtsang rgyal rtse'i skyed tshal du zin bris su mdzad pa de nyid cung zad nyob par 'dug pas/ go bde zhing gyer sla ba dbur stod 'bri gung du son pa skyu ra'i gdung las/ 'bri gung pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas rang lo drug cu pa shing pho rta'i lo tha skar can gyi dkar po'i bzang po gnyis par/ 'bri chos phyug klung gi sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu mgyogs par bris pa'o/// / ༈ /rjes chog ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs sho lo ka dang*/ bstod par 'os pa bcas kyis bstod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis nongs pa bshags/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// oṃ su+u pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes ye shes pa brtan bzhugs dang*/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/
bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'ang phyag len no// //maṅgalaṃ//
